name: Med Design Clinic Rayong

summary_en: Med Design Clinic Rayong is a skin care clinic located in Rayong specializing in botox, filler, and facial treatments. The clinic maintains a 5-star rating based on 5 total reviews and holds a trust score of 58.4.
